exposure: Prophylactic clindamycin 100 mg vaginal suppository (at bedtime for 3 nights before CS)
outcome: White blood cells count (24 hours after CS)
C-reactive protein level (24 hours after CS)
cohort: The study included 196 patients undergoing elective cesarean section, divided equally into an intervention group and a control group.
finding: Prophylactic administration of clindamycin vaginal suppository before elective CS significantly reduced the frequency of endometritis, fever, wound infection, and overall post-CS infectious morbidity.
mod_finding: Preoperative clindamycin vaginal suppository was found to be protective against post-CS infectious morbidities among patients undergoing elective cesarean section.
